scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('www')) fs.readdirSync('www').forEach(f=>{if(f!=='.nojekyll') fs.rmSync('www/'+f,{recursive:true,force:true});}); else fs.mkdirSync('www'); const copyDir=(src,dst)=>{fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f=>{const s=src+'/'+f,d=dst+'/'+f; if(fs.statSync(s).isDirectory()) copyDir(s,d); else fs.copyFileSync(s,d);});}; ['js','css','public','admin','staff','student','parent','assets'].forEach(dir=>{if(fs.existsSync(dir)) copyDir(dir,'www/'+dir);}); ['index.html','service-worker.js','CNAME','.htaccess'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f);}); console.log('Assets synced cleanly to www');"
scripts.apk:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
